data.description:
Über Odoo DE GmbH

Odoo entwickelt eine Suite von Open-Source-Betriebsanwendungen, die von CRM und E-Commerce bis hin zu Buchhaltung, Lager und Projektmanagement alle Bedürfnisse eines Unternehmens abdeckt. Das Ziel ist es, einer der weltweit führenden Open-Source-Anbieter zu sein und Software bereitzustellen, die gleichzeitig sehr einfach zu bedienen und voll integriert ist.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Business Advisor Enterprise übernimmst du die strategische Begleitung der digitalen Transformation von mittelständischen Unternehmen und Konzernen im DACH-Raum. Dabei arbeitest du unternehmerisch – von der ersten Analyse bis zum finalen Abschluss – und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf. 🤝

Es ist eine Rolle, die neben der Verantwortung des gesamten End-to-End Sales Cycles viel Beratung und Strategie verlangt - und das ohne lästige Kaltakquise.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du analysierst in Qualifizierungsgesprächen die Projektanforderungen und strategischen Herausforderungen potenzieller Kund:innen und baust ein fundiertes Verständnis für deren Business auf.

  • Du durchdringst die Geschäftsprozesse und Arbeitsabläufe in allen relevanten Abteilungen, indem du RFI/RFQs, Use Cases und umfassende Meetings als deine Werkzeuge nutzt.

  • Du entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungsstrategien und demonstrierst in überzeugenden Live-Demos, wie unsere Software zu den Bedürfnissen unserer potenziellen Kund:innen passt und ihre IT-Landschaft optimiert.

  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für C-Level-Entscheider:innen und unterstützt sie bei ihrer digitalen Transformation.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Business Analyst:innen zusammen - sowohl im Pre-Sales, um spezifische Lösungen zu erarbeiten, als auch während der Implementierungsphase in Steering Committees.

  • Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und klärst rechtliche Aspekte.

  • Du trägst mit deiner Erfahrung und deinen Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung des Mid-Market & Corporate-Bereichs bei.

  • Spannende Perspektive: Nach 6 Monaten hast du die Möglichkeit, in unser neu eröffnetes Office in München zu wechseln.

Das bringst du mit

  • Einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Diverse Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Consulting oder Sales / im Software- oder IT-Bereich

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch und Englisch (C1/C2-Niveau)

  • Analytisches Mindset - du hast ein Talent dich in komplexe Prozesse einzudenken und Probleme kreativ zu lösen

  • Hands-On Mentalität - du übernimmst Verantwortung und packst auch ohne feste Struktur an statt lange abzuwarten

  • Vertrauen und Enthusiasmus schaffen - du steckst andere mit deiner Begeisterung für unsere Software an

Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

Deine Benefits

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.

  • Sachbezug oder Urban Sports: Mit deinen monatlichen 50 € hast du die Wahl: Lass dir das Guthaben flexibel auf eine Mastercard buchen oder entscheide dich alternativ für eine Urban Sports M-Mitgliedschaft.

  • Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.

  • Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.

  • Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.

  • Go Global - Austauschprogramm : Lust auf Auslandserfahrung? Nach 2 Jahren Odoo hast du die Möglichkeit dich an einen unserer weltweiten Standorte versetzen zu lassen.

  • Faires Gehalt: Wir spielen mit offenen Karten. Abhängig von deiner relevanten Berufserfahrung liegt das OTE Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Rolle zwischen 63.000-71.000€.

Das ist uns wichtig

Bei Odoo setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, inklusives und authentisches Arbeitsumfeld ein.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller oder Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen.

Du hast Lust auf die Stelle, aber dein Profil passt nicht zu 100%.
Bewirb dich trotzdem! Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diesen Job!

Du liebst es, Outbound-Prozesse technisch zu automatisieren, datengetriebene Leads zu generieren und E-Mail-Infrastrukturen auf Skalierung zu trimmen? Dann passt du perfekt zu uns!

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Growth Engineer – Outbound & Data Automation (m/w/d) (in Vollzeit, als Freelancer oder Berater/Coach), der nicht nur E-Mails versendet, sondern als technischer Spezialist unsere Cold-Outbound-Infrastruktur auf das nächste Level hebt. Mit deinem starken IT-Background, tiefem Wissen rund um Tools wie Instantly sowie Automatisierungstools baust du hocheffiziente, datenbasierte Lead-Generierungssysteme auf.

Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Infrastruktur & Delivery-Setup: Du baust professionelle Cold-Outbound-Setups auf (Spintax, Domain-Warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Instantly) und stellst maximale Zustellbarkeiten für große E-Mail-Volumina sicher.

  • Cold Email Automation: Du richtest skalierbare E-Mail-Kampagnen in Instantly ein, optimierst A/B-Tests und steuerst den systematischen Versand über viele Accounts hinweg.

  • Data & Lead Scraping: Du nutzt IT- und Scraper-Tools (z. B. Clay, PhantomBuster, Apollo, API-Schnittstellen), um hochspezifische Zielgruppen-Daten zu extrahieren, zu bereinigen und anzureichern.

  • Prozess- & Workflow-Automatisierung: Du verknüpfst Outbound-Tools über Zapier, Make oder benutzerdefinierte Webhooks nahtlos mit unserem CRM und Vertriebs-Workflow.

  • Analyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du überwachst Reply Rates, Deliverability und Meeting-Booking-Raten datenbasiert und leitest kontinuierlich technische sowie inhaltliche Stellschrauben ab.

Was du mitbringst

  • Fundierter IT-Background (Verständnis von DNS-Einstellungen, Webhooks, APIs, Datenstrukturen und Automatisierung).

  • Tiefgehende Praxiserfahrung im Umgang mit Instantly (oder vergleichbaren Cold-Email-Tools) für das Versenden von Mails in hohem Volumen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Cold-Outbound-Bereich, in der datenbasierten Lead-Generierung und in der technischen Kampagnen-Steuerung.

  • Erfahren im Umgang mit Lead-Scraping- und Enrichment-Tools (z. B. Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) sowie Automatisierungs-Plattformen (Make / Zapier).

  • Du arbeitest hochgradig strukturiert, denkst analytisch sowie unternehmerisch und scheust dich nicht davor, selbst operativ mit anzupacken.

  • Kommunikationsstark auf Deutsch und Englisch. Offen für flexible Zusammenarbeit (Berater/Coach, Freelancer oder Festanstellung in Vollzeit).

Deine ersten Monate bei eFLY Marketplace Services GmbH

Du wirst dich schnell in unsere bestehenden Datenprozesse einfinden und erste eigene Automatisierungen für den Outbound-Bereich aufsetzen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team optimierst du die Lead-Generierung und treibst den Ausbau unserer Vertriebsstrukturen aktiv voran. Wenn du die meisten Anforderungen erfüllst und Lust auf diesen Bereich hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über das Portal.

Das bieten wir dir

  • 100% Remote & Flexibilität: Du arbeitest flexibel von wo du möchtest – egal ob in Vollzeit, als Freelancer oder strategischer Berater/Coach.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Impact: Maximale Freiheit und Verantwortung bei dem Aufbau und der Skalierung unserer technischen Outbound-Infrastruktur.

  • Tolles Team: Offene Kommunikation, echter Zusammenhalt und ein Ambitions-Level, das motiviert.

  • Top Ausstattung & Tech-Stack: Zugriff auf die besten Tools, Automatisierungssysteme und Budgets, die du für maximale Resultate benötigst.

About Wunder Mobility

Wunder Mobility builds the software that powers shared mobility worldwide. Our platform runs 20M+ successful trips yearly, processing 50M+ daily API calls, across 500 cities in Europe, the US, and Asia. Operators like Forest (London), Green Mobility (Copenhagen), and Flexar (Singapore) rely on us every day to move cities forward.

What you will do

  • Demos and pilots. Run demos and pilots for the deals our leadership leads, and set up each prospect's demo or pilot environment.

  • Onboarding and launch. Own the plan, the timeline and the customer relationship from signature to go-live, with a technical lead from our team.

  • Your accounts. Own adoption, health, NPS, renewals, upselling and cross-selling, starting with an existing customer and adding the new accounts you help win.

Along the way, you refine our demo and sales playbooks with the team and help build the AI workflows behind our customer work.

The AI you'll work with

  • From week one, you prepare customer calls, account health checks, and ticket replies with Claude and our own shared skills, connected to our tickets, CRM, meeting notes, and product data.

  • Our company knowledge base is written for people and AI alike, so answers start from how we actually work.

  • Our product has AI built in. With Wunder AI, operators ask questions about their own fleet and rental data. You show it in demos and help customers use it.

  • We have a company standard for how we use AI at work, and the whole team works to it.

  • We are a founding partner of House of AI Hamburg. It shares the room with our team and hosts several evening events a week for Hamburg's AI community.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in customer-facing B2B software roles where you owned accounts: customer success, account management, implementation or solutions consulting.

  • You have run demos and pilots, and you can explain a complex platform in the language of the customer's business.

  • You have taken customers from signature to go-live, with a plan, deadlines and several parties involved.

  • AI is part of your recurring work and runs on real data. In our first call, you show us one workflow (anonymised or on sample data is fine) and tell us what you check.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • You enjoy taking existing processes and playbooks and making them better.

Nice to have

  • Experience in shared mobility, at an operator or a platform provider.

  • Go-to-market or marketing experience.

  • Something you built with AI that other people now use.

What you can expect

  • A fixed salary of €65,000 to €80,000 per year, reviewed every 12 months.

  • The new accounts you help win, from demo to launch and beyond.

  • Direct work with our CEO and leadership on deals and customers.

  • The AI tools you need. Within six months, you own at least one AI workflow that the team or company uses, with time set aside to build it.

  • Written reviews of your scope and pay with our CEO and your manager: after your first launch, when your book reaches four accounts, and after 12 months at the latest.

  • Hybrid working: in our Hamburg office on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

  • A 2-year fixed-term contract with 6 months' probation

How we hire

  1. Apply with your CV and short answers (a few sentences each, or a Loom recording) to two questions: Which customer did you take from pilot or signature to launch, and what would you do differently next time? What is the most useful AI workflow you set up in the last 90 days, and when did you catch it being wrong?

  2. Intro call, 30 minutes, with our Head of Customer Success. You show us one AI workflow you use.

  3. Case, at most 3 hours of preparation: a demo and a launch plan for a fictional operator, based on a short brief we send you. Ideally not slides but an interactive page or prototype you build with an AI tool. You present it live in a 60-minute conversation with our CEO and our Head of Customer Success.

  4. If needed, a short final conversation with another member of our leadership team.

  5. Offer. We ask for references at this stage.

We reply within five working days after each step. You get feedback after the case and after the final conversation. Our Head of Customer Success is your contact from start to finish.

We won't make a decision before the end of December 2026.

Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise).

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht.

Deine Aufgaben

Team führen und Betrieb steuern

  • Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden.

  • Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen.

Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme

  • Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen.

  • Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration.

Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen

  • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

  2. Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie?

  3. Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?

data.description:
Du baust nicht nur Kampagnen, sondern den Kanal, über den eRecht24 verkauft

Bei uns ist E-Mail kein Begleitkanal, sondern der Kanal, über den aus kostenlosen Nutzer:innen zahlende Kund:innen werden und aus Kund:innen bessere Kund:innen. Wir haben kein klassisches Sales-Team. Was das Marketing nicht konvertiert, konvertiert niemand.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die diesen Kanal fachlich verantwortet: Strategie, Segmentierung, Automationen, Trigger, Testing, Zahlen. Hands-on in Brevo, im Austausch mit unserem Data-Team, im Sparring mit Product.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise). Unsere Kund:innen sind Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops, Agenturen und Webdesigner.

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen: viel Freiheit, viel Tempo, einiges noch unaufgeräumt. Brevo läuft, Kampagnen gehen raus, ein Data Warehouse liefert Segmente. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht: Lifecycle statt Gießkanne, Trigger statt Kalender, Tests statt Bauchgefühl.

Wie du bei uns arbeitest

Unser Marketing arbeitet in Squads innerhalb eines Marketing-Tribes. Du verantwortest den E-Mail- und CRM-Squad und arbeitest dort eng mit unserer E-Mail-Marketing-Managerin zusammen. Dein wichtigster Sparringspartner ist die Rolle Senior Marketing Manager Customer Journey: Sie orchestriert die Journey über alle Kanäle, du besitzt den E-Mail-Kanal in der Tiefe.

Die Grenze zu Product ist klar: Onboarding- und System-Mails gehören dem Produkt-Team. Du verantwortest die Marketing-Mails, also Konversion, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Retention und Winback, und stimmst Timing und Überschneidungen mit Product ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kanalverantwortung: Du entwickelst die CRM- und E-Mail-Strategie für unsere drei Kohorten und setzt sie um: Subscriber zu Freemium, Freemium zu eRecht24 PREMIUM, PREMIUM zu höheren Tarifen und Zusatzprodukten.

  • Automationen und Trigger: Du baust verhaltensbasierte Sequenzen in Brevo für Konversion, Upsell, Retention, Re-Engagement und Re-Permission, gespeist aus Plattform- und Tracking-Daten. Ein Teil dieser Infrastruktur entsteht gerade, zum Beispiel dynamische Angebotsblöcke in Mails, und du gestaltest mit.

  • Segmentierung mit Daten: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem BI-Team (Data Warehouse auf BigQuery) an Zielgruppen, Selektionen und Ausschlüssen. Du weißt, was du brauchst, und kannst es formulieren, gern auch in SQL.

  • Kampagnen und Copy: Du planst Kampagnen im Jab-Jab-Jab-Punch-Rhythmus (erst Mehrwert, dann Angebot) und in Batches, schreibst mit KI-Unterstützung auf Basis unserer Wording-Guidelines und finalisierst selbst. Fachinhalte kommen aus Legal und Content.

  • Kontaktregeln und Hygiene: Du definierst und setzt durch, wer wann was bekommt, zum Beispiel: Wer gerade in einer Sequenz steckt, bekommt keine Upsell-Mail. Dazu Listenqualität, Double-Opt-in, Einwilligungen, Bounce-Management und ein sauberer Umgang mit Inaktiven. Wir sind der Rechtssicherheits-Anbieter, unsere Mails sind es auch.

  • Testing und Zahlen: A/B-Tests (Betreff, CTA, Timing, Inhalt), Conversion je Kohorte, Umsatzbeitrag von E-Mail. Du verantwortest eine klare Zielzahl, den Umsatzbeitrag aus E-Mail, und berichtest monatlich, was funktioniert und was du deshalb änderst.

  • Schnittstellen: Customer Journey, Performance Marketing, Content, Product und Support.

Was wir nicht von dir erwarten

  • Ads schalten oder Social Media bespielen

  • Fachinhalte von Grund auf schreiben (die kommen aus Legal und Content)

  • Design (Vorlagen und Unterstützung sind da)

  • Personalführung

  • CRM-Administration oder -Customizing (Salesforce, Dynamics, SAP und Co.)

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 5+ Jahre E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM im B2B-, SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Kanalverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Lifecycle-Automationen und Segmentierung (Freemium-to-Paid, Upsell, Churn-Prevention), nicht nur Newsletter

  • Sicher in einem Automation-Tool (Brevo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud); Brevo-Praxis ist ein starkes Plus

  • Datenaffin: SQL-Grundkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu lernen

  • Conversion-Copywriting auf Deutsch: klar, kurz, ohne Marketing-Sprech. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch gut

  • Routine mit KI im Workflow und das Urteil, wann das Ergebnis gut genug ist

  • Hands-on-Mindset in einem Umfeld, das sich gerade professionalisiert

  • Plus: Legal-Tech-, Compliance- or Rechtsthemen-Hintergrund, Erfahrung mit CDPs oder Cross-Domain-Tracking, Matomo

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Der wichtigste Umsatzkanal der Firma liegt bei dir.

  • Daten sind da: BI-Team, Data Warehouse, Plattform-Tracking.

  • Kein Leerlauf: Ein Backlog an Kampagnen-Konzepten wartet auf jemanden, der priorisiert und rausbringt.

  • Kurze Wege zur Marketing-Leitung, zu Product und zur Geschäftsführung.

  • AI-first, organisationsweit und von der Geschäftsführung getragen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Keine Personalverantwortung, du berichtest an die Marketing-Leitung

Klingt nach dir?

15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und eine kleine Aufgabe aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Automation oder Sequenz hast du zuletzt selbst gebaut, und was hat sie in Zahlen gebracht?

  2. Mit welchem Tool arbeitest du heute, und wie groß ist die Liste, die du verantwortest?

  3. Wie entscheidest du, wer eine Mail nicht bekommt?

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Our aircraft work is scaling fast. Our Group 5 aircraft program runs alongside a growing set of research programs, with design, build, supply chain, and test all moving in parallel. We need one strong Program Manager to lead program management across all of it.

You will join our Program Management Office, reporting to the Director of PMO. You will take full ownership of our research programs and partner with the Director to run the aircraft program, owning cost, schedule, scope, risk, and the customer relationship. You will be the person who knows where every aircraft effort actually stands on any given day.

What you'll do

• Own our research programs end to end as the primary point of contact for government program managers and contracting teams

• Drive program execution on our aircraft program with the Director of PMO, from design reviews through fabrication, integration, ground test, and flight test

• Build and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS) across both efforts, tied to contract milestones and test events

• Own budgets and burn, track against funding, and flag variance early with a recovery plan

• Deliver contract requirements on time: CDRLs, monthly status and financial reports, technical reports, and final deliverables

• Run the program cadence: weekly reviews, technical interchange meetings, milestone reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR), and status to leadership and customers

• Run the risk, issue, and opportunity process and drive mitigations to closure

• Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and flight test, and deconflict shared people, hardware, and test assets between efforts

• Manage scope changes, contract modifications, and follow-on work with our contracts and business development teams

• Build the PMO tools and processes we will need as we add aircraft programs

What you bring

• 7+ years of program management, with at least 4 years owning cost, schedule, and technical performance on aircraft, UAS, or other aerospace and defense hardware programs

• Direct experience managing DoD research and development contracts (S&T, prototype, or 6.2/6.3 efforts)

• Track record taking aircraft or aerospace hardware through build and test, ideally to first flight

• Working knowledge of government contract execution: CDRLs, funded vs. ceiling value, modifications, and customer reporting

• Hands-on with IMS development (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet or similar), budget tracking, and EVM concepts

• Ability to run several efforts at once and make clear priority calls when they compete

• Clear, direct communicator who can brief an engineer, an executive, and a government program manager

• U.S. person status as defined by ITAR, and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Nice to have

• Experience working with DoD research labs and innovation organizations

• Program experience on Group 3 to Group 5 UAS, collaborative autonomy, or experimental aircraft

• Experience with OTA, SBIR/STTR, or other rapid acquisition contract vehicles

• Familiarity with airworthiness and flight test planning

• Background at a startup or fast-scaling hardware company

• Active Secret clearance or higher

• PMP or DAWIA Program Management certification

Location and details

• Location: Remote (U.S.), with regular travel to Oxnard, CA, customer sites, suppliers, and test sites

• Reports to: Director of PMO

• Export control: This role requires access to information subject to ITAR. Candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Us

We are a fast-growing data-as-a-service provider helping businesses access high-quality business data via a robust REST API. Our platform is trusted by many leading companies in their filed to power intelligent decisions, automation, and AI applications. We are now expanding our sales team with a technically skilled API Consultant to help customers succeed from day one.

Your Role

As an API Consultant, you will be responsible for ensuring customers achieve rapid and sustained success with our API and MCP solution, and just as importantly, for making them excited about it. You will be the face of Statista Connect in front of customers: pitching the solution, building and demoing custom agents live, and turning technical capability into a compelling story that wins hearts and budgets. You'll guide customers from initial setup to advanced use cases, drive adoption by crafting tailored prompts and agents, and help them seamlessly integrate our API solution into their workflows.

This is a hybrid role where technical expertise meets showmanship. If you light up when you get to demo something you built and watch a customer's eyes widen, this role is for you. If presenting to customers feels like a chore you'd rather delegate, it is not.

Key responsibilities

  • Pitching & Demoing (core of the role): Deliver compelling pitches and live demos of Statista Connect to prospects and customers, from analysts to C-level. Independently build and iterate on demo agents, prompts, and workflows tailored to each customer's use case — and use them to create genuine excitement and "I need this" moments in every meeting.

  • Customer Adoption & Enablement: Guide customers from initial setup to advanced use cases with tailored prompts, agents, onboarding flows, documentation, and tutorials — carrying the excitement from the pitch through to daily usage.

  • Data-Driven Engagement: Use product usage data, API analytics, and customer health scores to spot adoption blockers and expansion opportunities, and act on them with proactive guidance, lifecycle outreach, and new pitch angles.

  • Integration Success: Ensure smooth API integrations, resolve blockers quickly, document best practices, and collaborate with engineering on technical challenges.

  • Commercial Support: Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and support sales teams with demos and technical storytelling in renewal and growth conversations.

  • Feedback Loop: Share insights from pitches, demos, and usage data with product and engineering to sharpen the pitch, refine demo agents, and shape the roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • A Genuine Love of Pitching: Presenting energizes you rather than drains you, you've delivered demos or pitches before and seek out more. (If this doesn't describe you, this role won't be a good fit, and that's okay.)

  • Builder & Storyteller: You prototype agents, workflows, and prompts yourself, hands-on, and know how to turn technical capability into a business value narrative with maximum "wow."

  • API & Integration Experience: Background with API solutions, data integrations, or developer tools, comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, and authentication methods (OAuth, API keys).

  • Customer-Facing Technical Experience: Prior role as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Developer Advocate, Technical Consultant, or pre-sales-oriented CS, with proven success winning over customers.

  • Analytical & Communicative: Comfortable using product data and health scores to drive decisions, and able to explain technical concepts in a simple, engaging way to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

  • Problem-Solver: Quick to identify and resolve adoption blockers and guide customers through technical challenges.

  • Fluent proficiency in German

  • Bonus: Pre-sales or solution-selling experience, data pipelines, research background, B2B data solutions, or PLG environment experience.

Why Join Us?

data.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

THIS IS THE JOB

At everdrop we are creating innovative, plastic-free household and personal care essentials, that prove that sustainability, performance, and outstanding aesthetics go hand in hand. Our design team shapes every single touchpoint of the brand - from retail packaging on the shelves to digital campaigns. As a Working Student in our Design Team, you will be deeply integrated into our creative process. You’ll help bring visual concepts to life and ensure flawless execution across print and digital platforms.

As Working Student Graphic / 3D Design (m/f/d) these will be your tasks:

  • Assist in creating 3D renderings, product mockups, and visualizations for presentations and marketing purposes.

  • Help prepare print-ready artwork and ensure technical accuracy throughout the prepress process


DAS BIST DU

If you are passionately committed to sustainability and highly motivated to make the world a little cleaner with us, then we think you are really great! If you also like to work proactively and in a team, and you see every small and large challenge as an opportunity to get even better – then we are already a little bit smitten. Finally, if you also have the following skills and experience, we are almost certain: This could be the start of a great love story!

  • Currently enrolled in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Marketing, or a related field, with initial practical experience in graphic design, pre-press/print design, and 3D rendering.

  • Fluent in German or very good English skills (C1 Level), based in the Munich area with the ability to work on-site at least once a week, and available for 16–20 hours/week (full-time optional between semesters).

  • You are confident in Adobe Creative Cloud (especially Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), have an eye for typography, composition, colors, and materials, and a solid understanding of packaging design and print-ready prepress files.

  • Experience with 3D rendering and visualization software (e.g., Blender) is a strong plus.

  • An organized, structured natural communicator with excellent written and verbal skills who stays calm and keeps the overview during stressful phases.

  • Ideally you bring an understanding of German culture, lifestyle, and e-commerce.

THIS IS EVERDROP


Our Mission 💚🌱🌎

We want to change the world – together with you! everdrop's everyday products help people easily reduce their ecological footprint in the household. We started with our cleaning tabs in 2020. Since then, our household and personal care products have already saved more than 20 million single-use plastic bottles and thousands of tons of unnecessary CO2 emissions and chemical raw materials. By the way, we have been a certified B Corp since 2023. And with your help, we want to take everdrop to the next level. Join our mission – and help us make a sustainable lifestyle so easy that it becomes the new standard in our society.

Our Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • varied, meaningful, and purpose-driven work

  • great team spirit and regular team events

  • a beautiful, bright, spacious office near the Isar

  • an outdoor fitness facility next to the office (can be used anytime)

  • a monthly voucher for everdrop products in our employee shop

  • Family and Friends discount codes for everdrop and other Startups for Tomorrow companies

  • Membership with FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

  • flexible working hours

  • an additional 2 days paid vacation per year for your own environmental or charitable projects ("Green & Social Impact Days")

  • your own MacBook, as long as you work at everdrop

Our values 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

At everdrop, we want to live a culture of inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunities. The commitment to making the world a little better is part of our daily actions. Above all, we want to promote awareness for our planet and for other people.

One example of how we want to create awareness in the workplace: Menstruating colleagues who suffer from pain can easily take one or more "Power Days", which are additional paid days off. And this without questions, without justification. Another example: Our "Green & Social Impact Days" are two additional paid days off per year that you can dedicate to your own projects for the environment or for your community. We also try to be as mindful as possible in our hiring process.

We treat every person equally, regardless of origin, gender, religion, age, appearance, language, culture, nationality, marital status, sexual orientation, or physical disability.

We are certainly not perfect – but we want to get better every day and learn something new with every step. That's what every journey is all about. Are you coming along?

data.description:
At Knuspr, speed matters. Quality matters. But none of it works without people who know what they’re doing from day one.

That’s where our trainers come in.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Trainer who will help new colleagues settle in fast, learn the job properly, and grow into confident, high-performing team members. This role is part onboarding, part coaching, part culture-building — and a big part of what makes our warehouse teams work well together.

If you enjoy working with people, teaching by example, and helping others improve every day, this could be a great fit.

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll have a direct impact on how quickly new employees become productive and confident.

  • You’ll help shape team culture on the warehouse floor — not from behind a desk.

  • You’ll work closely with managers and become a key partner in performance, onboarding and development.

  • You’ll support both newcomers and existing employees, so no two days look the same.

  • You’ll be in a role where people genuinely rely on you — for guidance, clarity and support

What you’ll do

You’ll be responsible for helping warehouse employees learn, improve and succeed in daily operations.

You will:

  • Coordinate onboarding for new warehouse employees

  • Train employees across different warehouse departments and processes

  • Support the creation and improvement of training materials and methods

  • Give regular feedback, motivate people and help them improve performance

  • Identify where individuals need more support and create practical improvement plans

  • Check whether warehouse rules and processes are followed correctly

  • Work closely with managers on training progress and employee development

  • Help introduce new warehouse processes and make sure teams understand them

  • Evaluate training effectiveness and suggest improvements based on real needs

  • Be the go-to person for everyday questions, support and guidance on the floor

  • Act as a role model for Rohlik culture, teamwork and customer orientation

What we’re looking for

  • At least 1 year of training experience; warehouse or operations background is a plus

  • Open-minded, hands-on and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communicator with a natural feel for working with people

  • Calm under pressure and able to make quick, fair decisions

  • Structured, attentive and focused on helping others improve

  • Comfortable using apps, tools and new technologies

  • Self-starter who can work independently and get things done

  • Strong customer-oriented mindset, even in an operational role

Language requirements: You need professional working proficiency in English or German. Additional foreign languages are a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • Your work will have a direct impact on the company's results

  • We will implement your good ideas almost immediately – not waiting for the approval of the headquarters somewhere in the world

  • You will not be bound by corporate processes

  • Your work has to be innovative and meaningful, we do not want to follow trends, but set them

  • Last but not least, we offer a fair reward for your work and the possibility for professional growth and further education. We also offer you to be part of a great bunch of people and to attend a legendary corporate event.

SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily.

When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers. You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems, untangle their data and processes, and ship the solutions that make them successful.

This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics, or bring experience in technical product management, product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense: what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees.

Tasks

  • Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers

  • Owning customer implementations end to end, from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement

  • Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential

  • Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems

  • Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings

  • Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation

  • Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users

  • Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders

Communication and customer focus

  • You enjoy talking to customers: you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language

  • Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers

  • Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments

  • Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland

General Profile

  • Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much

  • Strong process understanding: you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain

  • High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments

  • This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience. Internships and working student jobs count too

Technical skillset

  • First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects

  • Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills

  • Product and design affinity: you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus

Bonus if you

  • Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP, integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too)

  • Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant

  • Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching

  • Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain

  • Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped

Benefits

  • A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders

  • Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly wellness budget

  • Access to the AI and productivity tools you need

  • Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland

  • Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares

About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience.

Step 2: Case study

A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer.

Step 3: Personal fit

Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & reference checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references.

Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

  • Explain and defend how to use AI effectively.

  • Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better.

Team

  • Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded.

  • Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

  • You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between.

  • You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off.

  • You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs.

  • A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake.

  • A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours.

  • Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models.

  • Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate.

How to apply

Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. The process has three stages: an engineering interview with the CTO, a travel-domain interview with the founder, and a practical case with a defence.

Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

This role can be office-based in Freiburg (Germany) / San Francisco (USA) or hybrid with a requirement to be in one of the offices one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why this role

Black Forest Labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. For a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. It's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. It has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.

We're hiring our first Brand Designer to define that brand and own it wherever people meet BFL. You'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how BFL looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.

This is a hands-on lead role. You'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. Over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at BFL, including who we hire next.

What you'll work on

  • Lead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from.

  • Create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do.

  • Make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print.

  • Own the direction of bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand.

  • Build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. We'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset.

  • Work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai, the Playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company.

Your team

Design at BFL is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. You'll help define these and represent design across the company.

You'll work closely with Devran, who leads design at BFL, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. Among the people you'll work with most are Owais and Aitana in marketing and Jay in growth engineering.

What we're looking for

  • At least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. We're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail.

  • Deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. You notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks.

  • A quality bar that raises the work around you. You've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave.

  • You're ready to ship from day one. You've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved.

  • A systems thinker. You've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind.

  • You move easily between the big picture and the details. You can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. One week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai. Much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity.

  • Curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. You can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work.

Nice to have:

  • Shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

  • Building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps.

  • Using generative image or video models in your creative process.

  • Motion, 3D or creative coding.

  • Experience at an AI lab.

How we work together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg or San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Please apply even if you don't match every line above. What matters most to us is curiosity and a love of making things. You don't need to know every tool we use. We'd rather hire a great, curious designer than someone who ticks every box.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU : €148K - €175K + equity
SF : $219K - $265K + equity

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by taking technical ownership of the electrical test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of electrical test equipment and functional-test capability for flight hardware, engineering models and test beds, from early definition through delivery, use and maintenance

  • Establish and maintain a practical development and readiness plan so that test equipment and software are available for early engineering-model testing and subsequent flight-hardware testing

  • Define and assess electrical test-equipment and functional-test needs, making requirements, interfaces, safety constraints, risks and dependencies visible and driving their resolution

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into complete, traceable functional-test strategies, procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Lead the electrical design, integration, build, troubleshooting and maintenance of test equipment and its software, including power, signal, communication and measurement interfaces

  • Develop and review automated functional-test software, data acquisition and test sequences in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand, with clear interlocks, limit checks, safe-stop behaviour and maintainable test records

  • Define and review test-equipment architecture, instrumentation, cabling, schematics, interface definitions, configuration and verification evidence

  • Plan and support test readiness reviews, ensuring that hardware, test equipment, software, procedures, safety controls and acceptance criteria are fit for use before testing begins

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware, including hands-on test preparation and execution

  • Lead technical investigation of test anomalies, assess test data, distinguish unit-under-test issues from test-system issues, and support non-conformance disposition, retest and closure

  • Coordinate electrical test activities and technical interfaces with MAIT, design, systems, software, quality and other relevant teams

  • Provide technical guidance and review to other engineers and technicians, sharing good practice in test design, execution, troubleshooting and evidence capture

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components where required

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Significant hands-on experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan and deliver electrical or functional tests for complex hardware, from requirements and interfaces through test execution and evidence review

  • Strong practical experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test strategy, procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly and commissioning of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop and review software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation, measurement-chain verification and systematic troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Experience preparing hardware and test systems for controlled testing, including safety controls, configuration management and objective test records

  • Ability to lead technical anomaly investigations, communicate uncertainty and risk, and agree evidence-based retest or closure actions

  • Experience providing technical guidance, reviewing work or sharing good practice with colleagues

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fuent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making.

  • Follow up with stakeholders to obtain status updates and clarify missing or inconsistent information.

  • Support Project Managers in the preparation, review and maintenance of their schedules.

  • Support the use of scheduling and project-management tools across the Nyx program.

Your Mission

At The Exploration Company, we develop, manufacture, and operate Nyx — a modular, reusable orbital spacecraft designed to be refuelled in orbit and transport cargo, with crewed missions potentially planned for the longer term.

We’re looking for a hands-on, technically mature professional with an engineering degree or extensive CNC experience to take full ownership of the machining process for space-grade components. You’ll be responsible for CAM programming, machine setup and optimisation, and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute directly to future investments in machining equipment and tooling.

You’ll work on a variety of high-precision parts, including rocket engine components, post-processed metal 3D-printed parts, and critical propulsion subcomponents. You’ll work across a fleet of modern, multi-brand, 5-axis machining centres and CNC lathes.

This role offers a high-impact technical position, with opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility.

Fluency in English is expected, as our work environment is international.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define and optimise machining strategies, including sequencing, tooling, fixtures, and in-process controls.

  • Program complex components in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software for 5-axis milling and CNC turning.

  • Validate parts using multi-brand CNC equipment, ensuring that they meet tolerance and surface-finish requirements.

  • Manufacture rocket engine components, precision assemblies, propulsion subcomponents, and Inconel structures, including setting workpiece origins and preparing cutting tools.

  • Perform first-line maintenance to keep machines in good working order.

  • Analyse and improve toolpaths, reduce cycle times, and stabilise machining quality.

  • Work with design, quality, and production teams to provide feedback, propose design improvements, and troubleshoot issues.

  • Lead equipment investment efforts, including specification development, supplier coordination, and commissioning.

Profile

  • An engineering degree or 5+ years of experience as a highly skilled technician in CNC/CAM machining of complex parts.

  • Expertise in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software and tight-tolerance machining.

  • Solid knowledge of 5-axis milling and/or precision turning.

  • Experience working with space or aerospace materials, such as Inconel, titanium, and other high-performance alloys.

  • An autonomous, hands-on approach, with the ability to structure and lead technical topics.

  • An interest in developing machining capabilities through process and equipment leadership.

Bei The Exploration Company entwickeln, fertigen und betreiben wir Nyx – ein modulares, wiederverwendbares Orbitalfahrzeug, das im All betankt werden und Fracht transportieren kann. Langfristig sind auch bemannte Missionen vorgesehen.

Du arbeitest an unterschiedlichsten hochpräzisen Bauteilen – darunter Komponenten für Raketentriebwerke, nachbearbeitete Metall-3D-Druckteile und kritische Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen. Dabei nutzt du einen modernen Maschinenpark mit 5-Achs-Bearbeitungszentren und CNC-Drehmaschinen verschiedener Hersteller.

Diese Position bietet dir eine technisch anspruchsvolle Aufgabe mit hoher Wirkung sowie die Möglichkeit, künftig zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, da unser Arbeitsumfeld international geprägt ist.

  • Raketentriebwerkskomponenten, präzise Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen und Inconel-Strukturen fertigen, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Werkstücknullpunkten und der Vorbereitung der Schneidwerkzeuge

  • Erstwartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten durchführen, um die Maschinen in einwandfreiem Zustand zu halten

  • Mit den Teams aus Konstruktion, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion zusammenarbeiten, um Feedback zu geben, Konstruktionsvorschläge einzubringen und technische Probleme zu lösen
